subject: physics

hotspots.label: Fall Together
hotspots.description: A transparent vacuum tube with a bowling ball and a feather — both fall together because gravity accelerates every mass equally.
hotspots.positionHint: Tall glass tube on the left with two objects at its top.
hotspots.function: Demonstrates equal fall acceleration without air resistance.

hotspots.label: Planet
hotspots.description: The source of the gravity in the scene — a round planet surrounded by inward field arrows.
hotspots.positionHint: A warm sphere center-right with arrows streaming to its heart.
hotspots.function: Acts as the center of attraction for field arrows and orbits.

hotspots.label: Field Arrows
hotspots.description: Arrows pointing toward the planet's center — every one shows the direction gravity pulls.
hotspots.positionHint: A ring of short arrows around the planet pointing inward.
hotspots.function: Shows the direction of the gravitational field.

hotspots.label: Satellite Orbit
hotspots.description: A satellite tracing a circled path — gravity bends its straight-line motion into an orbit.
hotspots.positionHint: A moon/satellite on a ring path above the planet.
hotspots.function: Shows gravity continually pulling a moving object into orbital path.

hotspots.label: 9.8 m/s² Tag
hotspots.description: The tag naming Earth's gravitational field strength — about 9.8 m/s².
hotspots.positionHint: A small plaque above the planet.
hotspots.function: Labels the field strength used for W = mg and falling.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette, no floor grid. A glass vacuum tube, a small warm planet with faint inward arrows, a satellite orbit ring, and a floating tag. Saturated color on arrows/satellite hotspots only. Soft neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0. Tube: glass-like with invisible walls (app keeps glass visible but not refractive). Planet: warm amber mottled sphere (roughness ~0.5). Arrows: matte blue ribbons. Orbit: soft green dashed ring. Tag: paper white.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: gravity as pull, equal-fall, and orbit binder.

GEOMETRY: scene centered. Left: a glass vacuum tube (cylindrical, tall ~3 units) with a bowling ball and a feather inside near its top. Right-center: planet sphere (r≈0.8) at (0.4,0.4,0) with a thin ring of inward arrows. Above the planet a dashed green orbit ring (r≈1.3) with a small satellite sphere moving along it.

INTERACTION: Drop animates the two objects falling with identical acceleration for equal-time landing; satellite slider drags the orbit radius.

NAMED NODES: VacuumTube, BowlingBall, Feather, Planet, FieldArrows, OrbitRing, Satellite, FieldTag. 6-10k tris.
